markdown: # BunkbedRevive Forked - This is a "fork" aka I added my own tweaks from the source ViViKo made available [here](https://discord.com/channels/1168655651455639582/1301621740312723537). Did this for my own modpack for me and my friends. Just wanted to fix some bugs that were reported. Tested it myself via 3 local instances and seems to be working fine? I do not promise any additional updates to this mod as it was for personal use, the original source is available, feel free to use it! ## Features - Pick up a dead player's body and bring it to the bunkbed to revive - Press E to revive them for a configurable cost - Should work in multiplayer ### Configuration Control how much revivals cost - **Percentage of Quota**: Pay a percentage of the current quota (default: 30%) - **Set Amount**: Pay a fixed amount of credits per revival Control how many times players can be revived: - **None**: Unlimited revivals (default) - **Overall**: Limited number of revivals per round for the entire team - **Per Player**: Each player has their own revival limit Advanced restrictions - **Teleported Bodies**: Choose whether bodies teleported via inverse teleporter can be revived - **Mangled Bodies**: Choose whether bodies cut in half (Barber) or with the head off (Coil-Head, head burst) can be revived. Off by default, like the Defibrillator in Usual Scrap - **Body Weight Requirement**: Control how much a body weighs All settings can be configured via the config file or in-game with [LethalConfig](https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/AinaVT/LethalConfig/). More info can be found on the [modding discord](https://discord.com/channels/1168655651455639582/1192228011836186776) Made with [LethalCompany.Plugin.Sdk](https://github.com/Cryptoc1/lc-plugin-sdk) by [Cryptoc1](https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/Cryptoc1/). ## Credit - [DiggC](https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/DiggC/) for config syncing - [MoonJuice](https://thunderstore.io/c/lethal-company/p/MoonJuice/) for all the beta testing - ViViKo for all their hard work and effort in creating this original mod.
